domain.text: Developer tooling for worker/orchestrator workflow and board-state coordination

impressions.text: The delivery addressed off-board worker messaging that could leave the board showing the orchestrator’s move while a worker was active.
The worker reported regression-first testing, 1,038 tests passing, and all listed local verification commands exiting successfully.
The orchestrator reported green CI and said the change merged cleanly; no prior review points, deviations, or unresolved blockers were reported.
